name: Follower ticker chip
oneLiner: a glass profile chip with a story-ring avatar: the follower count rolls on real odometer drums from the start number to the landing one while a Day tag flips over, then the number punches and a green gain chip pops
say: when the speaker tells a growth story with two numbers ('I started at 10,000 followers and 78 days later I was at 600,000'): cut in on the first number, the drum lands on the second; start/end are the two moments (Day 1 / Day 78, January / June), unit what grew (subscribers, readers, customers)
